description: Dock team agents only (others are refused). Saves a proposed new or updated help-center article as a DRAFT for the Dock team to review; it is never published by this tool. action "update" for an existing article (its slug from search_help), "create" for a new slug. body_markdown allows paragraphs, "## " subheadings, "1. " numbered steps, "Note: " lines, **bold** and [links](https://... or /help/...); no HTML, images, code or tables. Proposing the same slug again replaces that draft.

action.description: "create" a new article or "update" an existing one.

body_markdown.description: The article body in the restricted markdown subset, up to 20,000 characters.

slug.description: The help slug: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, e.g. 'connect-gmail'.

name: propose_help_article
